name: node-build
description: A tool to download, compile, and install Node on Unix-like systems.

issues.title: Suggestion/Feature: LTS Version marker on the install list
`nodenv install` tries to use python and fails on MacOS Monterey 12.3 and later and fails
`install` should fire hooks allowing plugins to set version for auto-installation
Feature Request: Allow only specifying a major version
